notes: Corrected: the apodosis complementizer that (t021) is no longer an `added` unit but joins the presentative וַיְהִי under rule 45, whose first case covers exactly this shape — a frame with a temporal phrase inside it and an asyndetic apodosis. The accepted note's premise, that no morpheme was available to carry the word, mistakes the condition rule 45 states.
The date phrase's assimilated articles are each aligned as real tokens under rule 12, and each ordinal's agreement article is `unrepresented` under rule 47.
v.35 is the other side of rule 45 in this chapter: there the apodosis does write its own waw, and that waw takes the that.
